hypothesis_prior.claim: Retrospective November 4 closeout, recorded at the actual save time, not a forecast made before the morning freeze. Retain the reduced $250m four-contract CORRA receive, with no add. I would initiate this reduced exposure from flat on the reviewed evidence: the frozen strip averaged 3.155%, 61.5bp over the 2.54% fixing, while underlying inflation was 1.85% and unemployment 6.5%. Those facts suggest the priced tightening path can outrun domestic persistence, although the realized BoC hike and expensive deferred energy are material contrary evidence. The authorized later election article strengthens the possible oil/disinflation channel, but does not prove peace, fiscal restraint, or a Canadian easing cycle. Carry and elapsed-time roll are conditional, not the edge by themselves. Higher U/Z rates alone do not justify concentrating there. Neither agent established that flat or U/Z-only has superior forward expected value. The existing position has earned no exemption from the same test used for new positions. CAD/NOK is a separate conditional opportunity; its possible shared oil exposure must be sized in aggregate, not vetoed as correlation.
falsifiers: A sustained rise in domestic underlying inflation, wages and employment that validates further BoC tightening would undermine the domestic-persistence premise.
A persistent or renewed deferred-energy shock and hawkish policy transmission could make the priced 2027 path reasonable; distinguish this from a temporary headline oil jump.

If the next shared marks show most repricing already realized, remaining edge may no longer justify retaining $250m even if the original thesis was right. A 3.35–3.40% strip is a review trigger, not an automatic add or mechanical stop.

forecast.expectation: Over the next one to three months, expect the Canadian 2027 H/M/U/Z average implied rate to fall if domestic underlying inflation and labor remain soft and the energy impulse fades. This prospective conditional forecast starts at trusted apply time; no claim is made that the later election information was known at the original freeze. Review retained size and profit realization against each new common packet.
forecast.horizon: 1–3 months from actual persistence; reassess next shared session
forecast.metric: Average implied rate of CORRA 2027 H/M/U/Z; domestic inflation/labor and deferred energy

why_not_the_same_object: CORRA and SOFR contract_period_months are 3. AONIA contract_period_months is 1.
An average of three monthly AONIA prints is an arithmetic mean of 30-day cash-rate futures.
A CORRA quarter is one three-month futures implied rate, quoted as 100 minus price.
Matching DV01 would still leave different accrual, different fixings, and intra-quarter path risk.
Canadian one-month CORRA futures in this packet stop at February 2027, so the 2027 quarterly strip has no monthly siblings here.
The US monthly-versus-SR3 comparison uses two sources and is an illustration, not a basis.

most_mispriced.path: CORRA quarterly period rates continue to rise through 2027 and 2028 (CRAH27 2.93, CRAZ27 3.265, CRAZ28 3.425) after the one-month curve has already reached the proxy midpoint by February 2027.
most_mispriced.expression: Keep the existing equal-weight receive of CRAH27, CRAM27, CRAU27, and CRAZ27.
most_mispriced.why_the_futures_path_is_wrong_under_the_: September underlying inflation transform 1.85 is near the temperature anchor and its impulse is negative. Unemployment transform 6.5 sits in a cool labor block. Ex-energy producer prices are stable to slightly down. The Nov 4 oil drop is large in log-change space and ordinary in level-percentile space. That combination does not validate a period-rate path that keeps climbing past the stored 2.75 midpoint into the mid-3s.
most_mispriced.what_would_make_the_futures_path_right: Scenario B: September's energy jump and rising CPI breadth pass into underlying inflation, and deferred oil premia return. Scenario C would also support a higher path if Canadian labor and demand reaccelerate despite the current 6.5 unemployment transform. Either outcome is a falsifier, not a probability.

forward_gap_versus_profit_since_entry.judgment: The strip average is 4.125bp below the previous morning vintage and 3bp below the Nov 4 12:12Z book mark. Under assumption A the remaining gap versus 2.75 is 36.375bp. The rally has not consumed that gap. This note does not size the keep.

falsifiers_and_horizon.horizon: Into the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z contracts. Review on the next shared packet.
falsifiers: Canadian underlying inflation, wages, and employment reaccelerate enough that a period-rate path above the 2.75 stall is validated. The September headline transform 3.0928 and rising major-component breadth are the current evidence that could start that pass-through.
Deferred oil premia return. The Nov 4 Dec-2027 Brent mark is 79.12, still 9.12 dollars above the July MPR prose assumption of 70, with the shock-persistence channel marked stale.
The four-contract average cheapens back through roughly 3.35 to 3.40 with domestic confirmation. That remains a review trigger from the prior hypothesis, not a new mechanical stop.
A later packet shows the four-contract average no longer materially above the 2.75 assumption. The keep case is about the remaining forward gap.
